title: [PresenceLobbyService] Could not create presence lobby: Object reference not set to an instance of an object
notes: Fix 2026-10-25 by Yash's session (e80f9a02d6): B37 (Docs/PartySystem/BUGS.md): likely cause - the presence join ran before Unity Services initialized / sign-in, so the SDK had no session service and the query and create threw a bare NullReferenceException. JoinOrCreateAsync now waits for Unity Services and a sign-in; a retryable create failure is a warning; any other is logged with its whole exception (stack). The lobby-less session itself was fixed 2026-10-08 (boot-time rejoin with back-off).
